career_ladder.note: Qualifying the Rajasthan Eligibility Examination for Teachers (REET) conducted by the Board of Secondary Education Rajasthan (BSER), Ajmer is the statutory prerequisite under Section 23(1) of the Right to Education (RTE) Act, 2009 for recruitment as Primary and Upper Primary Teachers in Rajasthan Government schools. Direct recruitment to the post of Grade III Teacher is conducted under the Rajasthan Educational (State and Subordinate) Service Rules, 2021, following which teachers advance through the State education cadre.

exam_scheme.note: REET is conducted in pen-and-paper offline OMR format across two distinct levels: Level 1 (Classes I to V, Primary) and Level 2 (Classes VI to VIII, Upper Primary). Candidates possessing requisite qualifications may appear in either or both levels. Each test comprises 150 multiple-choice questions carrying 150 marks for a duration of 150 minutes (2 hours 30 minutes). There is strictly no negative marking. Under Rajasthan Primary Education Department Order dated 16-03-2022, the REET certificate carries lifetime validity. Qualifying marks are 60% for General (55% for SC/ST/OBC/MBC/EWS, 50% for Widows/Ex-Servicemen, 40% for PwBD, 36% for TSP ST / Sahariya).

financial_package.note: Grade III Teachers recruited on the basis of REET eligibility certification are placed in Pay Matrix Level L-10 (corresponding to 6th CPC Grade Pay ₹3,600 in Pay Band ₹9,300–₹34,800) under the Rajasthan Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2017. As per Rajasthan Government finance rules, appointees serve a mandatory two-year probation period during which a fixed trainee remuneration of ₹23,700 per month is paid. Upon successful completion of probation, regular entry basic pay of ₹33,800 is drawn.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Rajasthan Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules 2017 Schedule I Level L-10 & BSER REET Guidelines
financial_package.estimate_note: Gross salary reflects post-probation regular pay comprising Entry Basic Pay ₹33,800 + 58% DA (₹19,604) + HRA ranging from 10% (₹3,380 in rural/Z-class stations) to 20% (₹6,760 in Y-class cities like Jaipur, Jodhpur, Kota). In-hand salary accounts for standard deductions under the National Pension System (NPS 10% on Basic+DA = ₹5,340), Rajasthan Government Health Scheme (RGHS), and State Insurance (SI). During the 2-year probation period, fixed remuneration is ₹23,700 per month.
official_perks: Cashless medical treatment for employee and dependents under Rajasthan Government Health Scheme (RGHS)
House Rent Allowance (10% to 20% based on city tier) or Government staff quarters where available
Summer and winter school vacation entitlements along with casual leave (15 days) and earned/half-pay leave
Maternity leave (180 days) and Paternity leave (15 days) as per Rajasthan Service Rules
Defined contribution pension under NPS and statutory State Insurance (SI) coverage

competition_benchmarks.note: REET is Rajasthan's largest public competitive eligibility examination, attracting 15 to 16 lakh candidates across Level 1 and Level 2. In 2022, 14,71,310 candidates appeared out of 15,66,992 registered applicants, and 8,07,145 candidates qualified (6,03,536 in Level 2 and 2,03,609 in Level 1) for recruitment against 48,000 Grade III Teacher vacancies advertised by the State Elementary Education Department.
